notes.title: Major Update v0.0.6 Car Wash & 25 Roofs and Ground Design & Vsync
notes.notes:
🅿️ 10 new roof styles added for parking spots (Each building has their unique roofs)
🧱 Each building now has its own ground upgrade options, with 18 new floor designs that also boost revenue
ːsteamthisː Vsync is available on settings
🚗 Car Wash area introduced at the Smashwich building
🎮 New car wash mini-game added for extra fun & challenge
👨‍🔧 New employee: Car Washer joins your team
🎵 Game song  added to the main menu – enjoy it anytime!
❓ Confirmation prompt added before spending skill points
🛠️ Repair key now includes a tutorial/info prompt on first use
🐛 Other minor bug-fixes

notes.title: v0.0.5.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
Time Jump XP issue is fixed
 Decor item prices are updated
 Level 1 requires 50 XP instead of 70XP

notes.title: v0.0.3 Bug-Fix Release
notes.notes:
Bug-fix release


 Fixed an issue where some cars could get stuck while valet driving.
 Resolved a bug where valets occasionally parked in occupied spots.
 Addressed an issue preventing Northern European countries from starting the day using the Enter button.
 Minor improvements and additional bug-fixes

notes.title: v0.0.2 Minor Improvements Update
notes.notes:
Thanks to your feedback we improved the minor tasks below. Many thanks your support!

[olist]
 Reduced the Number of Bollards for better accessibility
 Added "Max Order" & "Max Fill" Buttons for convenience
 Increased Marketing Skill Effectiveness – Attract more customers!
 New Interaction: Talk with other build sellers at the end of the day
 Minor Improvements & Bug Fixes for a smoother experience
[/olist]


*We will have a bug-fix update in a few days but we didn't want you to wait those improvements
